title: Decency descends along a quasi-compact surjective morphism
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that decency of an algebraic stack descends along a quasi-compact surjective morphism (author lemma at source lines 10465-10470, label lemma-qc-decent). The proof (source lines 10472-10490) uses surjectivity to write every point of the target as the image of a field valued point of the source, reduces by the criterion for decency to the quasi-compactness of a fibre product, and computes that fibre product as a base change of the (quasi-compact, by decency of the source) morphism from the source (proof lines 10473-10489). The reduction to the fibre product and its computation are the content. H2.
